notes.title: 0.9.0 Will of the Free Souls Update
notes.notes:
[h3]The heroes are coming with their——[/h3]  
[h1]Will of Free Souls!  ♪(^∇^*)[/h1]  
[h3]This update was originally planned to be included in the full release version... but we just couldn’t wait! 
[h3]I, Christy, will SING for everyone right now!![/h3]  

Okay, now for the detailed update notes:

[h2]★ New System — Hero Patrol Skill System[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Each hero unlocks a patrol skill after unlocking their 1st Story. Players can dispatch heroes to patrol, which means they assist other passing adventurers along specific paths in the park.  
[*] Heroes gain "Soul Energy" through adventures in the park. Each assist consumes a portion of this energy.  
[*] A new hero list interface has been added, where you can view the status of all summoned heroes and locate them easily.  
[*] Patrol skill instructions have been added to the manual.  
[/list]

notes.title: Happy 2025 & Patch in Progress

[h3]It’s a New Year~!
Happy 2025 to all park managers! Wishing everyone a fresh start and plenty of happiness discovering games you love~~[/h3]

Since the release of version 0.8.5, we’ve received a lot of feedback from players regarding the gameplay and issues within the game. Due to the significant adjustments made to the overall gameplay, some severe problems have arisen, causing inconvenience to your gaming experience. We sincerely apologize for this. Over the past ten days, we’ve released a series of small updates to address the most critical issues. We are still fully dedicated to fixing bugs and fine-tuning gameplay and numerical adjustments. In addition to the issues that have already been fixed, here are the ones we’ve identified and are currently working on:

· Abnormal Pupu statuses and building states (queue freeze) caused by the hosting feature after activating the Tower of Diligence: some identified causes have been fixed, and debugging is ongoing for the remaining cases.

· Late-game save file loss: this issue has been traced to functions related to the transformation buildings of the Tower of Wisdom. Repairs and testing are underway. If you encounter abnormalities in the save menu, please avoid repeated saving to prevent further loss. We will release an update soon to resolve this, allowing saves and loads to work properly again.

· Abnormalities in some hero tent/hero hotel commission progress: this issue is currently being tested and fixed step by step.

If you experience any of the above issues or other anomalies, please use the “Report Issue” function in the game to submit your save file. This will greatly help us locate and resolve the problems. Thank you for your support!

· Added the Adventure Journey feature, allowing adventurers of different identities to be assigned goals, sequences, and paths.

· Identity Summoning adjustment: Summoned identities can now be adjusted at the summoning circle anytime.

· Rent Payment System adjustment: At the beginning of each month, Joy Crystals from the previous month are automatically collected as rent payment. Any excess is returned as Goblin Coins, with fluctuations based on satisfaction during collection.

· Added the Goblin Shop: During rent collection each month, Goblin Coins can be used to purchase resources.

· Tower of Diligence adjustments: Removed the Public Dormitory feature. When the Tower of Diligence is activated, all idle Pipi in the nest automatically enter Hosting mode and will independently work at assigned buildings in hosting mode. The Exclusive Dormitory feature remains unchanged.

· Tower of Wisdom adjustments: Added the Energy mechanism. The fixed level-to-transformation-building relationship has been removed. Players can now freely choose unlocked transformation buildings within the energy limit.

· Challenge System adjustment: Removed the random trigger mechanism. Instead, three challenges will now remain constant in the park, updated at fixed intervals. Players can spend specific resources to take them on voluntarily.

· Adventure Building adjustments: Pipi can be assigned to work at buildings below their level, but this will consume additional stamina.

· Adjustment to adventurers’ Go to Room feature: When assigning adventurers to change their destination building, players can directly select the adventure goal to be executed at that building.

· Expand Land Plot adjustment: The expansion system now uses smaller land plots for more granular control.

· Swap Box adjustment: Now supports manual configuration of item types available for swapping.

[h2]💻 Logic Adjustments[/h2]

· Optimized room queuing logic and adjusted capacity limits.

· Adjusted adventurer satisfaction calculation: Satisfaction is now determined solely by the number of preferences (smiles) obtained during an adventure. Wishes and commissions no longer affect satisfaction.

· Overall adjustment to adventurer logic: Adventurers now follow designated adventure paths.

· Adjusted logic for adventurers gaining gold and enhancing combat power.

· Adjusted adventurers’ pathfinding mechanisms for wish- and commission-type adventures.

· Adjusted logic for adventurers’ selling activities.

[h2]💬 Content Adjustments[/h2]

· Revised building storylines, interaction requirements, and outputs based on the new commission, wish, and adventure path features.

· Adjusted adventurer identity preference types and adventure item categories.

· Adjusted Challenge content, rewards, and added difficulty tiers for progressive challenges.

· Added Development Points-related building technologies.

· Adjusted Policy Card effects.

· Revised tutorial steps and content, including guidance on Policy Cards, Challenges, and other features.

· Updated content in the manual.

[h2]🎨 UI Display & Operation Adjustments[/h2]

· Dragging operation adjustments: While constructing buildings or assigning adventurers to rooms, players can now drag the map with the right mouse button without exiting the current operation.

· Main page UI layout adjustments: Combined the timeline and calendar while adding a “Rent Estimate” feature.

· Adjusted the adventurer identity summoning interface to integrate assignment operations and identity information display.

· Revamped the building information interface, dividing it into three tabs: Basic Info, Building Technology, and Storyline.

· Rearranged tabs in the Commission Board by region based on unlocked buildings.

· Added new tooltips for clarity.

notes.title: 0.8.4 Truth of the Prisma Update!
notes.notes:
Hello! The "Truth of the Prisma" version has finally here today!
In this update, we bring everyone brand new park facilities of "the royal city" region, commissions, and a hero from "Research Story" – Vallee!

[h2]New Facilities:[/h2]
[b]Underground Dry Well:[/b] While exploring the underground relics of the Swamp City, adventurers stumbled upon a bright light, leading directly into the heavily guarded royal city!  Well, maybe with a little extra effort—and of course, nothing is a problem if it can be solved with money! However, to make adventurers truly feel the transition from Swamp City to the royal city, we PuPu have put a lot of effort into constructing these buildings!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/f8bf0757d3c0242aae9e5f31b354768403ecafdb.png[/img]

[b]Storeroom[/b]: With strict guards around, adventurers sneak into a small storage room only to stumble upon an unexpected find—(strikeout)—a contact! That's right, the first person you meet in any place is the most suspicious! This person will protect you all over the royal city, as long as you don't anger her.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/6192b9a02034a919f750bc10fdd1ed6017a89f01.png[/img]

[b]Southwest Tower[/b]: Don't be fooled by its appearance, it's actually the top of a very tall tower. But since the goblins imposed a height limit on buildings, we had to build only the top room of the tower for adventurers, complete with windows that aren’t too hard to flip! In this room, adventurers will encounter unexpected acquaintances and also expose their tracks due to traps, resulting in the “Curse of Misfortune” debuff—saving others while securing your own way out!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/6605e420ea2431633137cab62ed6f8da7daad383.png[/img]

[b]Palace Front Lawn[/b]: Just as various clues were gathered to move forward, adventurers inevitably encountered an ambush! Although victorious in battle, the outcome was quite tragic.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/e6a3985bfe443b7f013241058f736dd97f33e5ef.png[/img]

[b]Starry Chamber[/b]: The former observatory has now turned into a royal enchantment room. The impure use of magic power has also sparked thoughts of rebellion (yes, a typical trickster!) in the “Enchanter,” who secretly uses banned magic to help adventurers strengthen their equipment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/b188927c59ef199926017a6b6356d546bfccf76f.png[/img]

[h2]Major Boosts for Adventurers![/h2]
[b]Blacksmith - Equipment Strengthening[/b]: Just spend some ore to strengthen weapons or armor and enhance their basic properties!
[b]Starry Chamber - Weapon/Armor Enchantment:[/b] New effects for weapons like "Fire Spirit" and for armor "Thorns," significantly boosting adventurers' combat abilities!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/7eea2ac4b88e15f0df27c251ca1417a470676b7d.png[/img]

[h2]New Hero: Vallee[/h2]
[b]Coming from the Violet Archives of Shimmerbrook Town in "Research Story"—Vallee is now at PuPu's Park! [/b]Here, she carries her cherished harp, searching for flowers from her memories. She loves exploring vibrant places, seeking various plants and collectibles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/5c850d1af0c6d8b44a5ca91acce7d9e34ea51062.png[/img]

She also brings[b] 3 new commissions[/b] to the park and has recreated the observatory equipment, allowing for more powerful [b]weapon enchantments.[/b]
After completing commissions related to astronomy and mysticism, exclusive "Star Shards" will drop, which can be used to research new star decorations and flooring!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/ed7b5ce860fc762f6c74039ac94e57f1dbe9ed64.jpg[/img]

[b]About "Research Story"[/b]
This super cute pixel-art simulation game lets you explore, research various interesting creatures, cultivate them to enrich the town archives, meet friends in town, establish friendships (and some not-so-pure relationships), build your own farm, and more…
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/404a5f11df549e04bcf98f8c4fef43147a13441a.png[/img]
We played this game at last year's Beijing Nuclear Game Festival and met its developers, so we decided to have our characters visit each other's games! Here's what Water PuPu looks like near Shimmerbrook Town, hehe, it turns into a bottle!
 "Research Story" store page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1629830/_/

[h3]More importantly than the update content, we have restructured and modified the entire game's time framework in this version, involving all in-game timing, speeding up, pausing, etc., and we have made some changes to the previous speed-up function to increase the fast-forward speed![/h3]

Unfortunately, we couldn't implement all the royal facilities in this version. This update only includes half of the royal buildings, and in subsequent constructions, we are trying to create more lively and interesting scenes for the adventurers' "final battle" with interactions involving multiple adventurers and PuPus. Like this ↓
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/7a4eebf6559341b114d2b2dd2cc1750dbb3469c9.jpg[/img]

However, due to current limitations in the game code framework, we've encountered some difficulties in this part of development. So, we've decided to spend the next 3-4 months restructuring the overall AI logic for adventurers and heroes, the presentation and functionality of buildings, to support the development of systems related to multi-adventure-pupu interactions, hero skills, and the United Tower gameplay.

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
After a month of hard work, we are determined not to delay and bring you a new version before the holiday! 

[h2]Version 0.8.3, "Under the Volcano" is scheduled to be released on February 6th! We hope it adds some heat to your Chinese New Year! 🔥🧨[/h2]

[h2]In the 0.8.3 version, we've introduced a brand new map: the Volcanic Terrain.[/h2] Once you've successfully upgraded your Spring of Life to level 12, proving your excellent survival skills, it's time for your skilled PuPu to embark on more challenging adventures in the fiery Volcanic Terrain!
When you meet the requirements, you'll be able to select the "Volcanic Terrain" option in the land rental menu to start a new game in this thrilling environment. The entire map is covered in ash and darkness, with rocky outcrops, crevices, and lava flows. There are also several active volcanic vents.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/cbf8d5fb477dee96dbf0d080ab2bf4e2827f99f3.gif[/img]

In the Volcanic Terrain, you'll experience a new weather: Volcanic Eruption. During a volcanic eruption, your park will face various challenges. Some PuPu (like Water PuPu) will lose vitality rapidly due to the high temperatures, while others (like Fire PuPu) will feel incredibly lively and spirited. Your adventueres will also sweat more in the heat, so be prepared to catch those sweat droplets!
Additionally, near the volcanic vents, scorching lava may spill out and turn into rocks once it cools down. This can block paths or dirty up decorations, so you'll need to clean up accordingly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/9e06354a6ca42692746ac8df28bae506d50e9faf.gif[/img]

In this harsh environment, you may also encounter Acid Rain weather. Under acid rain, constructing various facilities becomes more challenging, and heroes are more susceptible to injury due to the corrosive rain.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/a2ca676bf0792f99e1e0428364b37bcdc9d2dcec.gif[/img]

Apart from the heroes who provide powerful Gem abilities, other heroes will vary based on the map. 
[h2]In this update, the Volcanic map introduces three new heroes:[/h2] Catgirl Nicole, Savage Esta, and Chieftain Romdo, along with their unique tent/lodge commissions. Nicole excels at fishing, Romdo is passionate about teaching enemies and protecting the weak, and Esta prefers to stay close to nature. How you utilize these heroes and commissions to enhance your park's development is up to you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/554ab621ca18ad93c7abc7d4c7b1d9ffecc92024.gif[/img]

In this update, we've also added new guestroom appearances for different heroes in the hero hotel. You can unlock these appearances by activating their journal stories.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/9d3d7223bf35dba8b0560e1a6a978a0e01fc74dd.png[/img]

[h2]Furthermore, the Stone City's building technologies have been expanded![/h2] In addition to some common effects, we've added effects that increase PuPu experience gain and provide extra experience for adventure identities.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/a739bf1af0bdc6c0f8485564a2342611bbaabefd.gif[/img]

To meet you all before the Chinese New Year, we've been working day and night on this version. After the holiday, we'll continue to update and refine terrain, hero-related content, and gameplay. Different maps will offer various challenges, and you'll have more strategic options to overcome terrain and seasonal challenges using different policy cards.
We're also working on hero skills that will directly impact park management, allowing heroes to play a more direct role in managing the park rather than just performing commissions at various buildings. In addition, while implementing new maps, we've encountered some challenging technical issues. Currently, there may be some lag during map generation and placement due to the instant calculation load. We're actively seeking solutions to make the gameplay smoother.

[h3]We hope you enjoy these new contents, and we look forward to bringing you even more exciting content in the future!

Thank you all for your care and support for PuPu‘s Adventure Park this year. We hope that in the new year, we can polish the game even better and transition smoothly to the next stage! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/1ccab51491431b14c4e8037b46293f2dedf37617.png[/img]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Long time no see! It's been a month since our last update! Today, we bring you some recent game development updates and adjustments!
Version 0.8.2 is the second major update since Early Access began. The game will focus on the Tower of Creation and the Park Decoration system for a series of gameplay and content updates.
In this version, the game will include two types of decorations: regular decorations and floor decorations. Players often hesitated to cut down the pink cherry blossom tree, and the PiPi found a way to let everyone keep it (with a slight twist).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/88809cae2aba6b7757824e159a6130e839646723.png[/img]

The "Tower of Creation" allows PiPi to showcase their creativity and discover various strange decorations in the Tower of Messengers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/1fa27fe0e43f22591122b9a86f4c27da00ed7ffd.png[/img]

Additional, update includes new PuPu nest conversion buildings, an increased level cap for the Fountain of Life, a new hero carrying Creation Gems, and more. We won't go into detail here, but everything will be explained in detail in the version update log later.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/a0f0a57c515d9d85480430f7df554afcb0c33388.png[/img]

Among the various modifications, two standout changes are worth mentioning. First, adjustments were made to the random map generation algorithm for the park. This introduces some fluctuation in difficulty and material output for the starting map, paving the way for future diverse terrains. Second, we revisited numerous issues with the hero inn assignments and carried out systematic optimizations. This includes the unlocking and posting of assignments, information transmission, and the logic for heroes taking on assignments, making it clearer and more understandable.

Moreover, due to players often encountering situations where a foolish hero meets a sincere PuPu, resulting in accidental creativity and massive losses in the park, we have carefully considered and added a micro-training "cheat code" for players to fine-tune their PiPi. If you encounter a tough opponent, give your PuPu a poke and see how it goes!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41029929/33c69a188c16f7c4c7f244454731b2f78c71e118.png[/img]

Currently, the version has been updated to the "playtest". The new version's content is still undergoing continuous debugging and adjustments, and it is expected to undergo the main game update around mid-December. More specific update details will also be posted in the Steam announcement when the version is released. Interested players can check it out there.
